profit_net removes an economy-wide depreciation ratio from gross operating surplus.

Transport costs go to truck transportation. With no place given, a product's retail margin goes to the store type that typically sells it (TYPICAL_STORE in build.py); products not listed use the household mix of store types.
State shares re-split only the seller's own value added; upstream industries stay national.
Negative scrap and used-goods rows in the PCE bridge (household sales, netted) are dropped from each line; their dealers' margins stay.
